interpretation: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base advantage is excluded under both interval methods; pooled and donor advantage remains unresolved under both. Uniform excludes useful advantage under writer resampling but remains unresolved under crossed resampling. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled comparisons remain unresolved at the useful margin under both methods; its uniform comparison excludes useful advantage under both, with worse performance resolved only under writer resampling. All other residual intervals include zero. Raw sums exclude useful base advantage under writer resampling but leave it unresolved under crossed resampling. Raw pooled advantage is excluded under both methods and donor advantage remains unresolved under both. All raw model-rival intervals include zero; raw sums are worse than uniform under both intervals.
